brief.headline: Massive overnight strike on Kyiv dominates; Ukraine hits Russian regions with 460 drones
brief.lead: The monitored channels overwhelmingly foregrounded a large combined missile-and-drone strike on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions, celebrated as retaliation targeting weapons plants and energy infrastructure, while a major Ukrainian drone barrage on Russian regions drove the day's sharpest negative sentiment.

developments.title: Channels tout massive combined strike on Kyiv and beyond
developments.body: Two Majors, Rybar and others claimed a large overnight strike on Kyiv, Kharkiv and Dnipro using cruise missiles, Iskander-M, hypersonic Zircons and Geran drones, causing power outages across five regions and water disruption in Odesa. Two Majors cited figures of 74 missiles and 496 drones; WarGonzo gave a lower count of 60+ missiles and 100+ drones. All figures are channel/MoD-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Strikes framed as hits on Ukrainian weapons production
developments.body: Poddubny and Kotsnews claimed the strike destroyed plants producing Flamingo missiles, Neptune rockets and Lutyi drones, naming the Kiev Radio Plant, Radionics and Antonov facilities. Claims are unverified and serve to justify strikes as military-industrial targeting.

developments.title: Ukraine launches large drone barrage on Russian regions
developments.body: Arkhangel Spetsnaza claimed Ukraine launched 460 drones on regions including Leningrad, Nizhny Novgorod and Stavropol; Two Majors reported the Kstovo oil refinery hit and fires, while also claiming air defenses downed 327 drones. Figures are MoD/channel-sourced and unconfirmed; this drove the day's negative sentiment spike.

developments.title: Channels amplify drone attack on border bus and Stockholm embassy
developments.body: Multiple channels reported a Ukrainian drone striking a civilian passenger bus at the Belarus-Russia border, wounding two and closing a checkpoint, and a paint/mock-bomb attack on the Russian embassy in Stockholm. Framed to emphasize alleged Ukrainian targeting of civilians and diplomatic sites.

developments.title: Frontline claims: advances toward Konstantinovka and Hulyaipole
developments.body: Sladkov+ and Two Majors framed Konstantinovka as the main Russian concentration point and springboard, while WarGonzo claimed control of Kopani and advances near Iskra on Hulyaipole; Kotsnews claimed the capture of Piskunovka. All are unconfirmed channel claims and drove a strongly positive frontline mood.

developments.title: West/NATO framed as escalatory and hollow
developments.body: Rybar highlighted Ukraine's €6.6bn EU Peace Fund request and an upcoming NATO Ankara summit with 5% GDP targets, while Two Majors flagged UK 'Brakestop' long-range missiles (up to 1200km). Poddubny and WarGonzo amplified Lithuania weighing removal of a constitutional ban on WMD deployment.

narrative_watch.title: Strikes recast as pure military-industrial targeting
narrative_watch.body: Channels consistently framed the Kyiv strike as hitting weapons plants, drone factories and fuel infrastructure, naming specific facilities to legitimize deep strikes and downplay civilian impact.

narrative_watch.title: European rearmament as self-serving and futile
narrative_watch.body: Kotsnews, Starshe Eddy and Poddubny push the line that European rearmament merely prolongs Ukraine's resistance while European militaries remain too weak for war with Russia.

narrative_watch.title: Discrediting Ukrainian air-defense claims
narrative_watch.body: NgP raZVedka mocked Ukrainian air-defense and casualty claims as mathematically 'impossible,' seeding doubt about Kyiv's interception successes after the strike.

mood_lines.text: Triumphalist; 22 posts celebrated the Kyiv strike as retaliation on weapons plants and energy grid, with net sentiment near maximum.
Sharply positive on claimed advances toward Konstantinovka, Hulyaipole and Piskunovka; sentiment jumped 28 points to fully positive.
Sentiment plunged 66 points to net -75 after 460-drone barrage, refinery fires and the border bus and Stockholm embassy attacks.
Uniformly hostile; framing NATO rearmament, EU funding and UK missiles as escalatory but ultimately inadequate against Russia.
Muted; an FSB treason arrest and commentary defending sustained pressure on Kyiv, low volume.
Limited to mocking Ukrainian military and air-defense claims; no criticism directed at Russian leadership.

flag_texts.title: Frontline sentiment jumps to fully positive
flag_texts.body: Frontline net sentiment rose 28 points to +100 as channels amplified claimed advances toward Konstantinovka, capture of Kopani and Piskunovka, and progress on the Hulyaipole direction.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine-strikes sentiment collapses 66 points
flag_texts.body: Coverage of Ukraine's claimed 460-drone barrage, the Kstovo refinery fire, the Stockholm embassy incident and the border bus attack drove net sentiment down to -75.

flag_texts.title: Watchlist topics silent
flag_texts.body: No posts on mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin were recorded today; the only 'criticism' posts targeted Ukrainian military claims, not the Russian leadership.
